title: Who Would You Take to a Deserted Island?

infobox.Spanish: ¿A quién te llevarías a una isla desierta?

text.lead: Who Would You Take to a Deserted Island? (Spanish: ¿A quién te llevarías a una isla desierta?) is a 2019 Spanish drama film directed by Jota Linares.
text.cast:
- Pol Monen as Eze
- Jaime Lorente as Marcos
- Andrea Ros as Celeste
- María Pedraza as Marta
- Beatriz Arjona as Maggie
text.release: The film screened in competition at the 22nd Málaga Film Festival on 22 March 2019.
